'''Feldip hills teleport''' scrolls are consumable [[teleport scrolls]] that teleport the player to the [[Feldip Hills]], near the [[Hunting expert]]. They can be obtained from all levels of [[Treasure Trails]] except beginner.

There are no requirements to use this teleport.[[File:Reading teleport scroll.gif|left|frame|A player using a scroll to teleport.]]
